Achievement.month-streak.Detail: Be active 30 days in a row. The longest uninterrupted run of calendar days with saved presses is used.
Achievement.app-keys.Detail: Make 10,000 presses across apps. Keyboard presses associated with active app windows are summed.
Achievement.speed-40.Detail: Reach 40 words per minute. Your best words-per-minute result among saved sessions is used.
Achievement.app-explorer.Detail: Be active in 30 apps. An app counts after its first saved key press or mouse click.
Achievement.perfect-line.Detail: Finish a session with 99.9% accuracy. Saved sessions with final accuracy of at least 99.9% count.
Achievement.marathon-day.Detail: Make 10,000 presses in a day. Progress is your highest saved press count in one calendar day.
Achievement.alphabet-practice.Detail: Press each letter A–Z 100 times. Progress is the number of Latin letters A–Z that each reached the required threshold.
Achievement.cursor-explorer.Detail: Move through 500 different heatmap cells. Distinct heatmap cells visited by sampled cursor movement count toward this goal.
Achievement.year-of-days.Detail: Be active on 365 different days. An active day is a calendar day with at least one saved press. Days do not need to be consecutive.
Achievement.scroll-atlas.Detail: Scroll 10,000 notches. Upward and downward scroll notches are combined regardless of direction.
Achievement.training-thousand.Detail: Type 1,000 correct characters in training. Correct characters are summed across all saved typing sessions.
Achievement.click-constellation.Detail: Make 100,000 mouse clicks. Saved clicks on registered mouse buttons are summed across your full history.
Achievement.app-regular.Detail: Make at least 100 actions in each of 10 apps. Each of ten different apps needs 100 saved key presses and clicks combined.
Achievement.erase-artist.Detail: Press Backspace 10,000 times. Progress comes from the saved all-time count for this exact key.
Achievement.key-collector.Detail: Use 60 different keys. Distinct physical key codes count after they appear in saved statistics at least once.
Achievement.key-river.Detail: Make 100,000 key presses. All saved keyboard presses count across your full history; progress does not reset.
Achievement.night-notes.Detail: Make 500 presses between 22:00 and 05:00. Saved presses in the specified hours or weekdays count using the computer’s local time.
Achievement.million-clicks.Detail: Make 1,000,000 mouse clicks. Saved clicks on registered mouse buttons are summed across your full history.
Achievement.training-ten-thousand.Detail: Type 10,000 correct characters in training. Correct characters are summed across all saved typing sessions.
Achievement.key-mountain.Detail: Make 1,000,000 key presses. All saved keyboard presses count across your full history; progress does not reset.
Achievement.alphabet-tour.Detail: Press every letter A–Z at least once. Progress is the number of Latin letters A–Z that each reached the required threshold.
Achievement.cursor-ten-km.Detail: Move the cursor about 10 km. Cursor travel is estimated from screen pixels at 96 DPI, so the distance is approximate.
Achievement.clean-paragraph.Detail: Type at least 200 characters without errors in one session. One saved session must have zero errors and at least 200 correct characters.
Achievement.speed-100.Detail: Reach 100 words per minute. Your best words-per-minute result among saved sessions is used.
Achievement.quiet-caps.Detail: Spend 30 active days without Caps Lock after the challenge begins. The challenge begins when achievements are first checked. Only days with keyboard activity count; pressing the forbidden key restarts progress.
Achievement.seven-days.Detail: Be active on 7 different days. An active day is a calendar day with at least one saved press. Days do not need to be consecutive.
Achievement.alphabet-master.Detail: Press every letter A–Z 1,000 times. Progress is the number of Latin letters A–Z that each reached the required threshold.
Achievement.cursor-day.Detail: Accumulate 24 hours of cursor observation. One cursor location is recorded each second. Seconds are combined across monitor layouts.
Achievement.ten-sessions.Detail: Finish 10 typing sessions. Completed and saved typing sessions in any language count.
Achievement.two-languages.Detail: Train in two languages. Distinct languages with at least one saved training session count.
Achievement.tab-regular.Detail: Press Tab 5,000 times. Progress comes from the saved all-time count for this exact key.
Achievement.hundred-sessions.Detail: Finish 100 typing sessions. Completed and saved typing sessions in any language count.
Achievement.perfect-ten.Detail: Finish 10 nearly flawless sessions. Saved sessions with final accuracy of at least 99.9% count.
Achievement.warmup.Detail: Make 1,000 key presses. All saved keyboard presses count across your full history; progress does not reset.
Achievement.speed-80.Detail: Reach 80 words per minute. Your best words-per-minute result among saved sessions is used.
Achievement.sixty-day-streak.Detail: Be active 60 days in a row. The longest uninterrupted run of calendar days with saved presses is used.
Achievement.first-clicks.Detail: Make 100 mouse clicks. Saved clicks on registered mouse buttons are summed across your full history.
Achievement.first-session.Detail: Finish a typing session. Completed and saved typing sessions in any language count.
Achievement.single-key-500k.Detail: Press the same key 500,000 times. Only the most pressed individual key counts. Presses on different keys are not combined.
Achievement.one-day.Detail: Be active on one day. An active day is a calendar day with at least one saved press. Days do not need to be consecutive.
Achievement.scroll-journey.Detail: Scroll 1,000 notches. Upward and downward scroll notches are combined regardless of direction.
Achievement.quiet-escape.Detail: Spend 14 active days without Escape after the challenge begins. The challenge begins when achievements are first checked. Only days with keyboard activity count; pressing the forbidden key restarts progress.
Achievement.thirty-days.Detail: Be active on 30 different days. An active day is a calendar day with at least one saved press. Days do not need to be consecutive.
Achievement.ten-thousand.Detail: Make 10,000 key presses. All saved keyboard presses count across your full history; progress does not reset.
Achievement.three-day-streak.Detail: Be active 3 days in a row. The longest uninterrupted run of calendar days with saved presses is used.
Achievement.first-steps.Detail: Make 100 key presses. All saved keyboard presses count across your full history; progress does not reset.
Achievement.cursor-mile.Detail: Move the cursor about one mile. Cursor travel is estimated from screen pixels at 96 DPI, so the distance is approximate.
Achievement.three-apps.Detail: Be active in 3 apps. An app counts after its first saved key press or mouse click.
Achievement.ten-apps.Detail: Be active in 10 apps. An app counts after its first saved key press or mouse click.
Achievement.busy-day.Detail: Make 1,000 presses in a day. Progress is your highest saved press count in one calendar day.
Achievement.scroll-cosmos.Detail: Scroll 100,000 notches. Upward and downward scroll notches are combined regardless of direction.
Achievement.single-key-250k.Detail: Press the same key 250,000 times. Only the most pressed individual key counts. Presses on different keys are not combined.
Achievement.key-collector-80.Detail: Use 80 different keys. Distinct physical key codes count after they appear in saved statistics at least once.
Achievement.enter-specialist.Detail: Press Enter 10,000 times. Progress comes from the saved all-time count for this exact key.
Achievement.single-key-100k.Detail: Press the same key 100,000 times. Only the most pressed individual key counts. Presses on different keys are not combined.
Achievement.hundred-days.Detail: Be active on 100 different days. An active day is a calendar day with at least one saved press. Days do not need to be consecutive.
Achievement.week-streak.Detail: Be active 7 days in a row. The longest uninterrupted run of calendar days with saved presses is used.
Achievement.space-explorer.Detail: Press Space 100,000 times. Progress comes from the saved all-time count for this exact key.
Achievement.weekend-maker.Detail: Make 5,000 presses on weekends. Saved presses in the specified hours or weekdays count using the computer’s local time.
Achievement.click-craft.Detail: Make 10,000 mouse clicks. Saved clicks on registered mouse buttons are summed across your full history.
